name: Easy Savory Shrimp Bread Pudding Casserole with Asparagus, Corn & Tarragon

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a large baking dish with butter.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunch asparagus
½ small pkg fresh tarragon
½ lemon

instructions.primary_message: Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into bite-sized pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Pick tarragon leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the asparagus. (If you don't have fresh tarragon, use 1 tsp of dried tarragon.)
Cut or tear the bread into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅔ (680 g) loaf rustic bread loaf

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Add to the bowl, along with corn, cream, and spices, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
1 ½ cups frozen corn
1 cup heavy whipping cream
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer shrimp mixture to the baking dish, spread out in an even layer, and dot butter over the top of the casserole. Tightly cover with aluminum foil and place in the preheated oven. Bake until casserole is bubbling and shrimp are cooked through, about 20 minutes.

When the casserole is done, remove from oven, uncover, and sprinkle with cheese. Return to the oven and continue to bake until the cheese is golden and melted, 5 minutes more. Remove from oven and let stand, 5 minutes.
Divide casserole between plates or bowls and serve with lemon wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
